summary: MasterBrand, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the FTC closed its investigation and the HSR waiting period expired for its merger with American Woodmark Corporation. MasterBrand is the acquirer via Merger Sub. No price per share, premium, or deal value is provided. The board has not issued a new recommendation in this filing; no advisors named. The transaction is expected to close on or about May 28, 2026, subject to other customary conditions. What to watch: any remaining closing conditions or last-minute regulatory hurdles. Risk-arb: focus on timing and satisfaction of remaining conditions.
